outcome_summary: All six deferred items from the `2026-08-04-knowledge-uuid-migration` synthesis were addressed. The implementation is test-only and comment-only — no production behavior was changed. All 266 knowledge-related tests pass after the changes.
project_summary: This project addresses all six deferred items from the knowledge UUID migration synthesis, covering test quality improvements, comment fixes, and test file maintenance with no production logic changes.
